sources.entry: Arc Browser - A modern, Chromium-based browser by The Browser Company designed around spaces, vertical tab layouts, custom “boosts,” and AI-powered enhancements via Arc Max. It’s offered as freeware, with premium features optionally layered on. #free

summary.name: Arc Browser
summary.one_liner: Arc is a Chromium-based web browser from The Browser Company, and this page is its post-download install guide for macOS.
use_cases: Browse the web with vertical tabs
summary.what_it_does: The page is a post-download confirmation with three steps for installing Arc on a Mac: open the installer from Downloads, drag the Arc icon into Applications, then add it to the dock and launch. The page text itself does not describe features. The directory listing that referenced it describes Arc as a Chromium-based browser by The Browser Company, built around spaces, vertical tab layouts, custom "boosts," and AI-powered enhancements via Arc Max. The listing also says it is freeware with optional premium features.
notable: Chromium-based browser by The Browser Company
Custom boosts and AI features via Arc Max (per listing)
caveats: Page only covers the macOS install steps; no Windows or other platforms are mentioned
Premium features are optional and their details are not on this page
